topic: ₹1L salary at 28: one sensible monthly split
caption:
28, earning ₹1 lakh a month, and broke by the 25th? Here's one sensible monthly split.

The classic 50-30-20 rule: 50% needs, 30% wants, 20% future. Indian life (metro rent, supporting parents, weddings, no big safety net) makes a case for flipping two numbers: 50% needs, 20% wants, 30% future.

On an illustrative ₹80,000 take-home: ₹40k needs, ₹16k wants, ₹24k future.

Fill the future bucket in order: emergency fund (about 6 months of needs), health and term cover, clearing costly debt, then long-term goals. Your EPF (12% of basic + DA) is already saving for retirement in the background.

Why not leave it idle? Retail inflation was 4.82% in August 2026.

Save this for salary day and send it to a friend who needs it.

Sources: EPFO FAQ on EPF contribution rates; MoSPI, CPI (Combined) for August 2026 (provisional). Salary split is illustrative, not a recommendation.
For education only. Not investment advice.
